data_fields.name: edelay_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: per-entity float multiplier on each frame delay (model default not read)

data_fields.name: edelay_modifier
data_fields.donor_constant: per-entity int64 static add after the factor (model default not read)

data_fields.name: edelay_range
data_fields.donor_constant: per-entity min and max of the raw frame delay that the scale applies to; max < 0 disables

data_fields.name: edelay_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: per-entity min and max of the scaled delay

best_idea: Each animation frame stores an absolute advance-at time from one authored delay scaled by a per-entity factor and modifier within range and caps, and a freeze moves that time forward one unit per logic step, so per-entity speed and hit-stop both come from data.
decision_why: The absolute next-frame time, one factor with range and caps, and the freeze that stretches the timeline fit windup speed and hit-stop, but the donor's frame timing is client presentation, so the server must keep its own tick timeline and take only the factor as data.
acceptance: A server test sets a windup factor of 0.8 and asserts the hit window opens 20 percent sooner in server ticks within the cap, and a two-tick freeze moves the hit window back by exactly two ticks; the Pit clip for the same attack uses the same factor.
